macro.note: LIVE as of 12:01 AM ET on roughly C$27.6bn of US-origin goods at 15, 25 and 50% - each rate matching the corresponding US rate good-for-good - across 600-plus product classifications: steel and aluminium, dairy, pulp and paper, appliances, electronics, agricultural equipment. macro.note: FOMC meets 15-16 September.
